title: #297 Gift
prompt: A gift (such as a camera, a soccer ball, or an animal) can contribute to a child’s development. What gift would you give to help a child develop? Why do you choose it?

promptSegments.text: A gift (such as a camera, a soccer ball, or an animal) can contribute to a child’s development.

angles.label: Point 1

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?

faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the importance of selecting a gift that promotes holistic development in a child, focusing on a soccer ball as an optimal choice due to its ability to enhance physical, social, and cognitive skills.
outline: Introduction: Present the significance of gifts in child development and introduce the chosen gift.
Body 1: Explain how a soccer ball improves physical health and motor skills.
Body 2: Discuss the social and emotional benefits of playing with a soccer ball.
Conclusion: Summarize the advantages of a soccer ball as a gift and reinforce its positive impact on a child's development.
keyArguments: A soccer ball fosters physical activity and motor skill development.
Playing with a soccer ball enhances social interaction and emotional well-being.

plan.focus: Discuss the importance of selecting a gift that promotes holistic development in a child, focusing on a soccer ball as an optimal choice due to its ability to enhance physical, social, and cognitive skills.
outline: Introduction: Present the significance of gifts in child development and introduce the chosen gift.
Body 1: Explain how a soccer ball improves physical health and motor skills.
Body 2: Discuss the social and emotional benefits of playing with a soccer ball.
Conclusion: Summarize the advantages of a soccer ball as a gift and reinforce its positive impact on a child's development.
keyArguments: A soccer ball fosters physical activity and motor skill development.
Playing with a soccer ball enhances social interaction and emotional well-being.
